name: W Budapest
positioning: A design hotel in the historic Drechsler Palace on Andrássy Avenue, opposite the Hungarian Opera House, with ballet- and chess-inspired interiors and an underground AWAY Spa
best_for: Design lovers who want a historic palace setting opposite the Opera House
Travelers who want a spa and a music-led social scene in central Budapest

facts.text: Original neo-renaissance features such as huge arched doorways and stained glass windows have been restored or faithfully recreated.
On Andrássy Avenue, the hotel sits beside luxury boutiques.
The hotel is close to the old Jewish quarter, known for its synagogue and street art.
The courtyard has a glass ceiling.
The Black Swan Penthouse Suite has a black marble bar wrapped in wallpaper by Adam Ellis Studio.
The W Suites represent the ballet Swan Lake and face the Hungarian Opera House.
AWAY Spa has an aromatic steam room, a Finnish sauna and a Beauty Bar.
With Omorovicza, AWAY Spa offers a mineral-powered treatment collection inspired by Hungary's thermal baths.
Le Petit Beefbar serves premium beef and comfort food with Parisian brasserie vibes inside the Drechsler Palace.
Music curator David Ráday curates the hotel's THE WARM-UP and AFTER DARK programs.
The seasonal outdoor terrace has views of the Budapest Opera House.
The Historical Rooms have arches on columns with carved-in sculptures and original ornament ceilings.

highlights.text: W Budapest is in the historic Drechsler Palace on UNESCO-listed Andrássy Avenue, opposite the Hungarian Opera House.
AWAY Spa is an underground retreat inspired by the city's thermal bath culture.
The White Swan and Black Swan Penthouse Suites have private balconies with views of the Hungarian State Opera House.
The hotel's design pays homage to chess, with black and white grid patterns from shower tiles to lift floors.
The fifth floor has a wood-centric style that highlights the palace's original and restored roof design.

considerations.text: For Opera House views from a standard room, ask for a front-facing room.
The surrounding area is a mix of glamour and grunge.
The hotel is aimed at music lovers and party-goers, with on-property parties and headliner DJs.
